selection_rule: Select whole perturbation seed grids, never individual favorable seeds. Internet Ads 5% label flip is the repeated strongest discovery condition; HTRU2 10% label flip, Dry Bean 1% label flip, and MicroMass 1% sample deletion are retained as near-boundary or contrasting conditions. Every listed seed and all four generators are included.
structures: Each original/perturbed representation is fitted once, with the primary v1 preprocessing and generator random state fixed at 1. Structures are then held fixed while decisions change.
native_rule_scope: For all v1 repository implementations the available native prediction is the radius-aware boundary-distance rule. Its equality to the common radius-aware rule is reported, not hidden.
